title: Alam Mere Murshid Ghazi ka
body:
Maula ghazi, maula ghazi..(8)
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghazi, Ya Ghazi..
Ya Ghazi, Ghazi, Ghazi
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ki paak dua bankar..(3)
ab ghar ghar par lehrata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tera maula ghazi kya kehna
tere darr ki naukri kya kehna
teri karam nawazi kya kehna
tere naam ki haziri kya kehna
jaha'n dastarkhwan ye sajta hai..(2)
us ghar ki shaan badhata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mai ghum se jab ghabrata hu to paas alam ke jaata hu
ro ro ke maula ghazi ko
mai dil ka haal sunata hu
mere sar par saaya karta hai..(2)
meri himmat aur badhata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Ya Ghazi, Ya Ghazi..
Ya Ghazi, Ghazi, Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Abbas karam farmao na..(2)
kabhi mojiza ye dikhlao na
mere ghar bhi saja hai tera alam
kabhi mere ghar bhi aao na
sarkaar mere ghar aaenge..(2)
mere dil ki aas bandhata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ye parcham aman ka naara hai
ye parcham paak sahara hai
tu pyaar kare to tera hai
mai pyaar karu to mera hai
jo iske deep jalata hai..(2)
ye uske bhaag jagata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zawwar jo ghar se chalta hai
ye uspar saaya karta hai
ghar se ghar tak pohchane ki
abbas zamanat deta hai
laakho zawwar jo chalte hai..(2)
unhe karbobala pohchata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Ya Ghazi, Ya Ghazi..
Ya Ghazi, Ghazi, Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ha mashk o alam se yaad aayi
pyaas asghar aur sakina ki
mazloom hussain ki tanhayi
zainab bazaar mein kyu aayi
jab paak alam ye uth-ta hai..(2)
har manzar yaad dilata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jab aath moharram aati hai
ghazi ki yaad dilati hai
jawwad o sarwar ye duniya
abbas ka sog manati hai
us waqt juloos e matam mein..(2)
har matamdaar uthata hai
<<MINI>>
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
Mai naukar, ha mai naukar, ha mai naukar maula ghazi ka
alam mere murshid ghazi ka..(2)
